question: Who has officially become the world’s richest actor, crossing the billionaire threshold with a net worth of $1.4 billion?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shah Rukh Khan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Shah Rukh Khan has officially become the world’s richest actor, crossing the billionaire threshold with a reported net worth of **$1.4 billion** (₹12,490 crore).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Shah Rukh Khan’s wealth comes from multiple streams, including his production company **Red Chillies Entertainment**, ownership in **Kolkata Knight Riders**, and various high-value **endorsements and brand deals**.
 
• His net worth places him ahead of international stars like **Taylor Swift**, **Arnold Schwarzenegger**, and **Tom Cruise**.
 
• In the 2025 Hurun India Rich List, he is the first Bollywood actor to become a billionaire, with a net worth of ₹12,490 crore.
 
• Despite this, he is not the richest Bollywood celebrity overall, as **Ronnie Screwvala** holds that distinction with an estimated net worth of $1.5 billion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Red Chillies Entertainment**__: Shah Rukh Khan’s production company involved in film production, visual effects, and digital content creation.
 
• __**Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR)**__: An Indian Premier League (IPL) franchise co-owned by Shah Rukh Khan, which has been a lucrative investment.
 
• __**Endorsements and Brand Deals**__: Shah Rukh Khan remains one of the most sought-after celebrities for high-value endorsements across various industries.
 
• __**Ronnie Screwvala**__: The founder of UpGrad and an industrialist, who holds the title of the richest Bollywood celebrity with a net worth of $1.5 billion.
